nodes.text:
Some basic FAQs about HMPV so that people don't fall for misinfo circulating on internet
1. HMPV Human Meta Pneumono Virus was first found out in 1958 by a grp of dutch scientist. It's not a new virus like COVID 19
2. It has similar symptoms as common colds sometimes asymptomatic https://t.co/WwLoOgQZkD

nodes.author: Vshwax
nodes.text:
3. It mostly affects Pediatric populations below the age of 5 years. And it's mostly prevalent in winters in the month of Dec-Jan as per historic data
4. It is an Acute Respiratory Infections so people with underlying conditions eg diabetes, and weak immune are most affected.

nodes.author: Vshwax
nodes.text:
5. As per CDC/WHO, there is no antiviral therapy and vaccine for HMPV only support over a period of weeks can help
6. Historically, cases of HMPV emerged in 2003 in Pune, 2006 at AIIMS, 2013 again Pune @ NIV, and then 2024 in Bengaluru. All happened during peak winters ( Dec-Jan)
